venira.output_kind: rows[] {session_id, operation, outcome, reason_code, reason, args_hash, command, request_id, started_at_ms, completed_at_ms, elapsed_ms, args_summary, result_summary, result_bytes}, count, truncated, chain_ok (verify=true). Output mode full adds redacted args and result per row; bulk text is kept as its length only. Timestamps are epoch milliseconds (since_unix filters in seconds). args_hash identifies the call, command is the redacted command line.
venira.speed_profile: fast; one bounded SQLite read (readonly, WAL-safe).
venira.use_when: you review what ran and how it ended, or look one job up by request_id.

description:
Read recent audit-log rows, newest first: what each job was asked and returned. Filter by session_id, operation, outcome, request_id, since_unix (seconds); verify=true checks the hash chain.
Use when: you review what ran and how it ended, or look one job up by request_id.
Avoid when: you want live metrics (health).
Output: rows[] {session_id, operation, outcome, reason_code, reason, args_hash, command, request_id, started_at_ms, completed_at_ms, elapsed_ms, args_summary, result_summary, result_bytes}, count, truncated, chain_ok (verify=true). Output mode full adds redacted args and result per row; bulk text is kept as its length only. Timestamps are epoch milliseconds (since_unix filters in seconds). args_hash identifies the call, command is the redacted command line.

limit.description: Max rows, newest first (default 50; 15 in VENIRA_OUTPUT_MODE=compact; max 200).

operation.description: Only rows for this operation (e.g. edit_file, shell_run).

request_id.description: One job by request_id: its args and result.

since_unix.description: Only rows at or after this Unix timestamp (seconds).

verify.description: true verifies the audit hash chain and returns chain_ok; false disables verification.

name: read_audit
title: Read audit log
